description: List the comment threads on a media file, with the file's current transcriptRevision. Each thread is its first comment with `replies` (oldest first). A comment on words carries an anchor (startWord, endWord, exact, times, status as in list_media_labels); a whole-file comment has none. A deleted first comment that has replies stays with an empty body and isDeleted true. Anyone who can open the file can read its comments.

filter.description: all (default), open or resolved threads, or file for whole-file comments only

name: list_media_comments

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: List Media Comments
